name: DevDeskApp - All-in-One Developer Utility Suite & Security Engine

parameters.content:
## 🚀 DevDeskApp All-in-One Suite
**How it works:**
This workflow demonstrates real-world developer utilities running 100% locally with zero external server dependencies.

### ⚡ Test with 1 Click:
Just click **'Test workflow'** at the bottom - no webhook or API setup required! All sample data is pre-configured.

## 🔐 Data Cleaning & Security
1. **Prettifier:** Unpacks minified JSON into clean human-readable trees.
2. **SHA-256 Hasher:** Generates cryptographic tamper-proof digest.
3. **UUID v4:** Stamps every payload with a unique RFC 4122 trace ID.

## 📊 HR & Business Math
4. **Slugifier:** Cleans candidate name into URL-safe ID.
5. **CTC Calculator:** Computes monthly take-home, employee/employer PF, professional tax, and income tax breakdown.
